features.name: Updated Power BI app for purchasing
features.description: Enhanced Power BI application for purchasing analytics to help procurement managers forecast future procurement needs, analyze supplier quality, and dive into supply chain risk.

features.name: Open source Power BI app code
features.description: All code for the Power BI app for purchasing is being open sourced.

features.name: Purchase quantity by location visual
features.description: Updated visual showing purchase quantity across different warehouses including posted purchase invoices and return orders.

features.name: Purchases by item report
features.description: Updated report with two new visuals showing purchase flow by fiscal year and item category, and financial versus quantity exposure by item category.

features.name: Pareto analysis for vendors
features.description: Vendor analysis showing what percentage of purchase value is supplied by top vendors, allowing visibility into supplier concentration risk.

features.name: Vendor geographic location mapping
features.description: World map visual showing vendor locations to identify geographic supply chain risk and concentration.

features.name: Purchases by purchaser report
features.description: New report showing purchase quantity and amount by procurement officer to identify concentration risk and potential single purchaser vulnerabilities.

features.name: Purchases by warehouse location analysis
features.description: Analysis showing risk exposure to different warehouses and identifying potential bottlenecks in operations.

features.name: Purchase returns overview report
features.description: New report showing purchase returns by reason code including damages, defects, and warranty to identify quality and financial risk.

features.name: Purchase quote overview report
features.description: New report providing overview of purchase quotes to identify potential fraud risk or abnormal quoting behavior by purchasers.

features.name: Key purchase influencers report
features.description: AI-driven report showing statistical analysis of factors influencing purchase documents and segmentation patterns, available for different document types.
caveats: Demonstrated with sample data that may not be representative

features.name: Vendor quality analysis report
features.description: New report identifying single supplier risk across items and item categories, showing vendor concentration and financial exposure for each product.

features.name: Purchase forecasting with machine learning
features.description: AI-based forecasting capability using statistical models on historical transaction data to predict future purchase amounts. Includes configurable seasonality settings and upper/lower bounds, allowing users to adjust parameters based on business needs.
caveats: Requires manual adjustment based on business seasonality
Predictions are based on historical transaction windows
Report parameters must be edited to customize for specific needs

features.name: Vendor concentration risk visualization
features.description: Power BI visualization showing vendor risk exposure, identifying single-vendor dependencies and supply chain vulnerabilities. Highlights items at risk if a particular vendor cannot deliver.
caveats: Manual action required based on insights
Helps identify risk but does not eliminate it

features.name: Enhanced purchasing app with new Power BI pages
features.description: Updated purchasing app featuring four new report pages and four updated pages in the Power BI analytics. Provides multiple personas and scenarios for procurement risk management.
caveats: Requires installation or update of the app
